## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: Static guard in applier matrix raises DsoIdLabelWriteError if any path attempts dso-id label write outside two authorized paths

Implement _audit_dso_id_label_writes(leaf_name: str, mutations: list[Mutation]) -> None in applier.py: if leaf_name not in _AUTHORIZED_DSO_ID_LABEL_WRITERS and any mutation has target=='label' AND payload.startswith('dso-id-') AND action in {'create','update'} -> raise DsoIdLabelWriteError(leaf_name, offending_mutation). Wire into apply() so it executes AFTER every leaf returns its mutation list, BEFORE mutations commit downstream. Authorized leaves pass unchanged. Sentinel test monkey-patches audit helper and asserts it's invoked once per leaf execution within single apply() call.

## Test Approach
Given unauthorized leaf 'inbound_update' + mutation list with one Mutation(target='label', payload='dso-id-abc123', action='create'); When _audit_dso_id_label_writes called; Then DsoIdLabelWriteError raised, message references offending leaf + payload. Sentinel: patched counter; When apply() runs across all 9 leaves; Then counter == 9.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py
- [ ] Unauthorized leaf attempting dso-id label write raises DsoIdLabelWriteError
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py::test_unauthorized_leaf_raises_dso_id_label_write_error
- [ ] Authorized leaves (inbound_clean_label, outbound_create) pass audit without raising
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py::test_authorized_leaves_pass_audit
- [ ] apply() invokes _audit_dso_id_label_writes once per leaf (sentinel)
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py::test_apply_invokes_audit_for_every_leaf
- [ ] Non-dso-id label mutations from unauthorized leaves do not raise
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py::test_audit_ignores_non_dso_id_label_mutations

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py — Edit
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
data.title: Add _audit_dso_id_label_writes guard called from apply() per-leaf
